operator: hostapd 2.11 and dnsmasq 2.92 in an OrbStack Ubuntu 26.04.1 arm64 VM; local NL80211_CMD_CONTROL_PORT_FRAME helper; the console owner reconnected for the control and for each EAPOL case

console.model_source: owner manual confirmation; PTP DeviceInfo reports the generic model 'Nintendo Switch'
console.firmware_observation_note: The console was not enumerated during this test; the firmware value is the owner's report.
console.modification_source: owner report; this test does not detect modifications

control.result: control passed; the console processed the hostapd group rekeys and stayed associated

batch.console_error: 2110-3128 at the connect-to-internet step on every automatic Test Connection
batch.network_settings: The two test networks remain saved on the console; no other console setting was changed. The WPA2 test passphrase was changed locally to TX10LED1 and is not published.

capture.hostapd: timestamped debug log; association, handshake, group-rekey, and disassociation times come from hostapd
capture.pcap: local-only AP-interface capture of DHCP, DNS, and TCP traffic
capture.eapol: the one-frame cases were sent through the AP control port; the console's EAPOL processing is inferred from association state and the control group-rekey behavior
capture.management_frames: not applicable; the AP was WPA2 and hostapd handled the handshake

interpretation: The control passed: the console completed the WPA2 pairwise handshake, processed three hostapd group rekeys, and stayed associated for 35.4 seconds, so the console's EAPOL-Key path is reachable and responsive. Batch 1 sent one EAPOL-Key frame per association with E-01-E-08 malformed header/descriptor fields. All eight control-port sends were accepted, the station was still associated 10 seconds after every frame, and the association lifetimes were 35.0-35.4 seconds - indistinguishable from the control. No crash, reboot, hang, or new console error occurred. This is a clean negative for the tested header/descriptor cases, not proof that the deeper key-data parser was reached; the frames carried a zero MIC, which may cause the console to discard them before deeper parsing. H-011 remains UNVERIFIED; Batch 2 (E-09-E-14) was not run.
authorization: The owner approved the Phase 3 control E-C only, then the full Batch 1 sequence (E-01-E-08, one frame per association, eight frames total). The owner reconnected the console for the control and each case. No EAPOL frame outside the approved cases was sent.
limitations: One console, one adapter, one driver, and channel 1 only.
The hand-built EAPOL-Key frames carried a zero MIC; the console may discard them before parsing the deeper key-data fields.
The control used hostapd's own group rekey, not a hand-built pairwise rekey.
The console automatically runs Test Connection on each association and fails at the internet step with 2110-3128 because the AP has no NAT; this timing is part of the observed behavior.
The console may ignore duplicate or unauthenticated EAPOL frames, so the batch does not prove the malformed fields reached the parser.
The two test networks remain saved on the console until the owner removes them.
No crash, hang, or reboot occurred; this is not an exploit or a memory-safety proof.
